primary_failure.leadership_transition: Standby transitions to Leader upon receiving 2/3 votes

dual_failure.cluster_state: Cluster fails closed safely; writes rejected until quorum restored

fencing_token.mechanism: Monotonically increasing epoch number signed with quorum certificate
fencing_token.stale_leader_rejection: Requests with stale epochs (epoch < highest_seen) strictly rejected with StaleEpochFencingError
